import time
import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import SGDOneClassSVM
from sklearn.svm import OneClassSVM
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Example 1: SGDOneClassSVM with 10k samples and 1000 features
try:
    np.random.seed(42)
    X_large = np.random.randn(10000, 1000)
    
    start_time = time.time()
    model1 = SGDOneClassSVM(nu=0.01, verbose=10, random_state=42)
    model1.fit(X_large)
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM with 10k samples and 1000 features, nu=0.01, verbose=10, default tol::n_iter_", model1.n_iter_)
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM with 10k samples and 1000 features, nu=0.01, verbose=10, default tol::elapsed_time", elapsed)
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM with 10k samples and 1000 features, nu=0.01, verbose=10, default tol::elapsed_time_rounded", round(elapsed, 2))
except Exception as e:
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM with 10k samples and 1000 features, nu=0.01, verbose=10, default tol::n_iter_", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))

# Example 2: SGDOneClassSVM on iris dataset with specific parameters
try:
    iris = load_iris()
    model2 = SGDOneClassSVM(nu=0.1, max_iter=100, tol=1e-3, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3, random_state=42)
    model2.fit(iris.data)
    
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=0.1, max_iter=100, tol=1e-3, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3).fit(iris.data)::n_iter_", model2.n_iter_)
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=0.1, max_iter=100, tol=1e-3, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3).fit(iris.data)::n_iter_ > 6", model2.n_iter_ > 6)
except Exception as e:
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=0.1, max_iter=100, tol=1e-3, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3).fit(iris.data)::n_iter_", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))

# Example 3: SGDOneClassSVM vs OneClassSVM comparison on iris dataset
try:
    iris = load_iris()
    X = iris.data
    
    # Standardize features
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
    
    nu = 0.1
    
    # Train SGDOneClassSVM
    sgd_model = SGDOneClassSVM(nu=nu, max_iter=20000, tol=None, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3, random_state=42)
    sgd_model.fit(X_scaled)
    
    # Train reference OneClassSVM
    ref_model = OneClassSVM(kernel='linear', nu=nu)
    ref_model.fit(X_scaled)
    
    # Get predictions and decision functions
    sgd_decision = sgd_model.decision_function(X_scaled)
    ref_decision = ref_model.decision_function(X_scaled)
    
    sgd_pred = sgd_model.predict(X_scaled)
    ref_pred = ref_model.predict(X_scaled)
    
    # Get coefficients
    sgd_coef = sgd_model.coef_.ravel()
    ref_coef = ref_model.coef_.ravel()
    
    # Calculate correlations
    decision_corr = np.corrcoef(sgd_decision, ref_decision)[0, 1]
    pred_corr = np.mean(sgd_pred == ref_pred)
    coef_corr = np.corrcoef(sgd_coef, ref_coef)[0, 1]
    
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=nu, max_iter=20000, tol=None, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3) compared to OneClassSVM(kernel='linear', nu=nu)::decision_function_corr", decision_corr)
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=nu, max_iter=20000, tol=None, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3) compared to OneClassSVM(kernel='linear', nu=nu)::pred_corr", pred_corr)
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=nu, max_iter=20000, tol=None, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3) compared to OneClassSVM(kernel='linear', nu=nu)::coef_corr", coef_corr)
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=nu, max_iter=20000, tol=None, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3) compared to OneClassSVM(kernel='linear', nu=nu)::sgd_n_iter_", sgd_model.n_iter_)
    
except Exception as e:
    probe("SGDOneClassSVM(nu=nu, max_iter=20000, tol=None, learning_rate='constant', eta0=1e-3) compared to OneClassSVM(kernel='linear', nu=nu)::decision_function_corr", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))
